errors.message: Turbopack repeatedly logs "Can't resolve 'tailwindcss' in '/home/ujjwal/Documents/10 saas app/apps'" during dev compile. Pages still render 200 OK and styled HTML is served. Likely caused by Next.js inferring the workspace root one directory above the app due to a sibling package-lock.json — set `turbopack.root` in next.config.ts to silence and ensure correct module resolution paths.

chrome-devtools MCP browser profile (/home/ujjwal/.cache/chrome-devtools-mcp/chrome-profile) was held by a concurrent agent for the entire run, so live console-error inspection and click interaction were not performed. Fell back to HTTP probes; all 8 routes returned 200.

build.notes: Compiled in ~20s. 23 routes generated. Build emitted a deprecation warning that the `middleware` file convention should be renamed to `proxy`, plus a workspace-root-inference warning — both informational, not blocking.
